case: PostgreSQL bytea[] XLSX re-import through LibreOffice Calc
contract: The PostgreSQL bytea[] contains non-UTF-8 bytes 00ff275c, empty bytea and SQL NULL. Native pg_typeof, array_to_json, array_send, and unnest element-hex checks verify type, bytes, ordering, empty value and NULL.
BookieE exports the bytea[] textual form into an XLSX shared-string cell without a formula.
LibreOffice Calc opens the workbook and saves ODS, then reopens ODS and saves XLSX; the cell remains a string with identical content.
The retained array text is {"\\x00ff275c","\\x",NULL}; the two binary elements and SQL NULL remain separately represented.

bookiee_export.command: rtk proxy env BOOKIEE_XLSX_REIMPORT_ARTIFACT=<evidence-dir>/source.xlsx cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration binary_array_file_export_contract::value_contract_bytea_array_file_exports_preserve_binary_elements -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

steps: In the pinned Debian image, install libreoffice-calc; Calc opens source.xlsx and saves calc-roundtrip.ods.
Calc reopens calc-roundtrip.ods and saves calc-roundtrip.xlsx.

consumer_assertions.method: Python standard-library ZIP/XML checks require an XLSX shared-string cell and ODS string cell, exact array text equality across all formats, and no formula elements.

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Spreadsheet-application re-import for other PostgreSQL array families and other spreadsheet applications remains open in B3.
